title: fix(driver-memory): a preset dateRange on a date field counts the reference zone's calendar days, from UTC westward too
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_

Fixes #27272

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：内存驱动的分析查询里，预设日期范围（如“本季度”）落在声明为 `date` 的字段上时，改为按参考时区的日历日计数；`datetime` 字段仍按时刻比较。这条窗口规则从 service-analytics 挪到 `@objectstack/core`，两边共用同一份。
- 为什么改：从 UTC 往西（洛杉矶，连 UTC 本身也是），“本季度”会漏掉 7 月 1 日、多算 10 月 1 日，报表数字静默出错；上海只是碰巧算对。
- 风险与回滚：只影响“预设范围 × 已声明为 date 的字段”，在内存驱动上；显式起止日期、datetime 字段、未声明类型的字段行为不变，service-analytics 行为不变（只是改为调用 core）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.ts` 末尾新增的两个导出；`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics.ts` 的 `parseDateRangeString`；`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts` 删掉的旧副本。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-memory exec vitest run src/memory-analytics-date-range-date-field.test.ts`，预期 7 条全过，其中洛杉矶、UTC、上海的 this_quarter 都只列 7/1 和 9/30。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The rule has one home.** ADR-0053's window rule (a `date` column compares the calendar days the period covers in the reference zone; a `datetime` column compares instants) was spelled once, in `service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts` (`dateRangeWindowBounds` over the private `inclusiveCalendarDayWindow`, PR #27271). `@objectstack/driver-memory` depends only on `core`, `spec` and `types`, so it cannot import that. Both functions move, unchanged in behaviour, into `@objectstack/core`'s `utils/analytics-date-range.ts`, beside `resolveAnalyticsDateRangeString`, whose header already says the lowering lives there because these two faces cannot import each other. `dataset-executor.ts` imports both from core and re-exports `dateRangeWindowBounds`, so the four service-analytics importers keep their import line. Nothing in `packages/spec` moves.

**The memory face uses it.** `MemoryAnalyticsService` asks the driver whether the time dimension's field is declared `date`. If it is, a preset resolves through `dateRangeWindowBounds(window, timezone, true)` to the inclusive day pair, and the existing bound construction reads that pair exactly as it reads a caller's bare-day `[a, b]` (`$gte` first day, `$lt` the next day after the last). Every other field keeps the instant window it had.

**One driver accessor.** The declared kind lives in `InMemoryDriver`'s private `temporalFields` (filled by `syncSchema`), so the driver gains `isDeclaredDateField(object, field)`, the same pattern as `filterComparandStorageForm`. An object never declared answers `false`: the driver does not guess types from values.

**Surface widening.** The order's file surface was `memory-analytics.ts`, its test, the rule's home and `dataset-executor.ts`. It grew by `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts` (the accessor only) and `packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.ts` (+ its test), on the seat's call (option A; option B, inferring the kind by probing a comparand's stored shape, was refused as a type guess from a value). `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `@objectstack/core` gains the exports `dateRangeWindowBounds` and `inclusiveCalendarDayWindow`, and `InMemoryDriver` gains the public method `isDeclaredDateField`. Nothing is removed or narrowed. One changeset, `patch` for `core`, `driver-memory` and `service-analytics`.

## Tests

- New `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics-date-range-date-field.test.ts` (7): the card's rows (06-30, 07-01, 09-30, 10-01), clock frozen at 2026-09-09, declared via `syncSchema`. `this_quarter` in `America/Los_Angeles`, `UTC` and `Asia/Shanghai` selects 07-01 and 09-30; Los Angeles `this_month` selects 09-30 and not 10-01; an explicit `['2026-07-01', '2026-09-30']` is unchanged. A declared `datetime` field keeps the zone-midnight instant pair (both edges pinned one second either side). An undeclared field keeps the instant pair.
- `packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.test.ts` (+5): the rule itself, three zones, the non-date arm and the explicit arm.

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation, for triage to rule on if it disagrees: an undeclared field keeps the instant window.** The card measured the undeclared case wrong as well. This PR follows `dateRangeWindowBounds`' own contract from #27172 / PR #27271, "a column whose type the caller cannot name answers `false` and keeps the instants", and this driver's rule that it does not guess types from values (`memory-temporal.ts`). So a bare day stored in a field the driver was never told is `date` is still compared to the preset's instants as text. Making it count calendar days would need the face to read the type from the stored value, which is the option the seat refused.
- The face's `$or` over both stored forms is unchanged; on a declared `date` field the `Date` arm reads the day pair as UTC midnights, as it does for a caller's bare-day window.
- No behaviour change in service-analytics: its four call sites resolve the same function, now from core.
- The branch carries two early WIP commits (`7cd672d6`, `46faf53d`) committed without the session trailer pair; the final commit `4ddf1d4a` carries it. The branch name is not `claude/issue-*`, so it is not force-pushed and history is not rewritten.
